cases.detail: Platform administrator opened Digital Adoption websites and the selected approved loopback registration through its Manage website link.
Website map showed seven persisted observed pages, download, paging and description controls; no import or rescan was claimed.
Ten persisted teaching workflows displayed with draft/published/disabled versions; no publication was changed.

Selected website shows zero saved groups and explicitly states that offline panels receive no queued commands. Revocation/extension mutations are covered by isolated regression, not this read-only check.

Consent-required scoped report loads 12 structural events, page/form/cohort sections and JSON export; it explicitly distinguishes browser IDs and submission attempts from people/business saves. No analytics setting changed.
Local attachments, visitor-confirmed pairing and linked workflows are enabled; shared knowledge requires authenticated management. Permissions, identity scope and Action Policies were left unchanged.

Authorized user view ran existing read-only UAT Copilot Inspect. Run 4067 failed immediately with COPILOT_GROUP_ACCESS_DENIED for the unavailable saved group. No task was delivered or queued; this is a negative access-boundary check, not successful online execution.

Run 4068 completed via the real Flolah engine and connector. Local browser reported 1 form, 3 required fields and 4 navigation links, effect_observed, zero host writes. Evidence: ../workflow-live/run-4068.png and recipient.json.

Run 4069 reused the published read-only definition and same saved target group after coordinator/gateway restart. No new pairing, link code or group ID update between runs. Recipient and server both completed; zero host writes. Evidence: ../workflow-live/run-4069.png and recipient.json.
